explanation: Job 1 corrupts the provenance handoff by replacing each demand record identity with its source identity. The downstream job then receives evidence_sources with record_id values s01..s08 instead of n06-r01..n06-r08, so prioritize cannot join ranks back to coverage records and every observed upstream_rank is 0. This violates the requirement to preserve record identities and upstream provenance order.
cited_evidence: assemble_provenance source appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), ...}, changing record_id to source_id.
Job 2 input evidence_sources contains records like {'rank': 1, 'record_id': 's01', 'source_id': 's01'} while needs use record_id values like 'n06-r01'.
Observed Job 2 priorities show upstream_rank: 0 for all eight records, proving the provenance ranks did not join to the retained demand record identities.
